brief: 新增測試群組後，群組總數檢查仍用舊數字，讓健康的把關被誤報成失敗。
detail: Fresh Gate 的 ios-device-lock registration source `12e5e1364e5b491303a13a0818fc9efa56c33f55` 已把 `ios-device-lock` 加入 `ops/test_ops.sh` 的 DEFAULT_TESTS；`ops/tests/ops_group_chain.py::case_arms` 因而解析出 56 個 arms。`ops/tests/test_ops_group_chain.py::test_case_arms_covers_every_group_in_test_ops` 仍硬編 `assert len(arms) == 55`，註解也仍寫 53 DEFAULT + 2 optional，造成 Gate 唯一的 inventory mismatch。以該 source worktree 實跑 `uv run pytest -q ops/tests/test_ops_group_chain.py`：1 failed、7 passed，失敗正是 56 != 55。修復只更新 `ops/tests/test_ops_group_chain.py` 的 inventory baseline（以及必要的 focused invariant），不修改 `ops/test_ops.sh`、不把其他 Gate debt 混進來；若新 primary 尚未包含 ios-device-lock，preflight 必須停止而非自行補入該群組。
plan: On an integration base that contains the ios-device-lock DEFAULT_TESTS arm, update only `ops/tests/test_ops_group_chain.py`: replace the stale 55-arm inventory/comment with the current 56-arm inventory and add a focused invariant that the parsed arm count matches the declared DEFAULT_TESTS plus OPTIONAL_TESTS set. Preserve the existing required-arm and wildcard negative checks. Do not change `ops/test_ops.sh` or absorb unrelated Gate debt. If the selected base does not contain ios-device-lock, stop as a baseline mismatch instead of adding the group in this ticket.
scope: 一個群組 inventory assertion 與一支精準 pytest regression，限定在測試盤點檔。
